body.statement: The outward inverse satisfies \(\Pr_P\{\mathcal D(P)\subseteq\mathcal D_n\}\ge1-\eta\) uniformly over \(\mathcal M_d^\circ\). Conditional on \(\mathcal D_n\ne\varnothing\), reporting only arrows present with the same orientation in every \(G\in\mathcal D_n\) controls the probability of any false compulsion by \(\eta\).
body.justification: Inference targets the full non-singleton population fiber and therefore avoids false certainty from graph-then-report workflows.
body.gap: Strieder et al. invert tests for linear-model effects and Wang et al. give asymptotic ordering sets; neither covers every graph in a strict PB-SCM population fiber with finite-sample probability.
body.consumer: The football-event and shopping-mall analyses can report only causal arrows supported simultaneously across structural and sampling uncertainty.
